name: 6529-validator-mod
description: Set up and watch a 6529 validator on your own DigitalOcean server, step by step in a pane beside the chat. Uses DigitalOcean's own doctl; the mod never holds your token or keys.

sshKey.title: SSH key (optional)
sshKey.description: Optional. The private key your servers trust, for example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. Leave empty to choose it in the pane. The mod reads only its public half; a key with a passphrase needs ssh-add first.
